notes: ἀπήλασεν keeps only its verb word: the expressed ἀπό is rendered 'from', whose gloss carries the preverb's sense, so rule 106's first arm applies.
βῆμα heads on 'seat', the noun glossing the lexeme, with 'judgment' as the modifier; 18:12 and 18:17 read the same lexeme the same way per rule 24.
